description.p: NeverTube is a lightweight YouTube client built with Qt5 and C++17. It streams directly from YouTube with libmpv: no browser, no Electron and no bundled web engine.

ul.li: Play videos and live streams, with hardware decoding when the GPU supports it.
Search with live suggestions, and open a pasted YouTube link directly.
Browse channels, playlists and the watch history.
Keep an "up next" queue seeded with YouTube radio, with shuffle and repeat.
Resume where you left off and show the progress on the thumbnails.
Download a video (or only its audio as mp3) and play the file back locally.
Use a mini player while you browse.

description.p: New modern media controls overlay, YouTube playlist and mix support in Search, Channels, and Up Next queue.
First Flatpak build: bundled libmpv, FFmpeg and the downloader's ffmpeg CLI.
